summary: Steep parked-up kerb on Stanley Terrace, with houses about 10-12 m behind.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11 m back at 13 m along and 9 m back at 45 m along; the gap between them is open front lawn and trees, so the section sits roughly 10-15 m from the nearest home.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with cars parked on it, room to pull fully off the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way street with a junction at the far end; cars parked on both sides.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this kerb, so a van fits in. 2P limit applies, with resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

flags: Steep: about 11% grade here, 9.5% mean, max 12.8%
Homes about 10 m away on the same side
2P parking signs, resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm
Noise from through traffic and the junction
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; trees on the north side shade parts of the kerb, with the morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: North kerb of Stanley Terrace, in front of the lawn between two houses, where cars are parked
